parsed.note_claim: The video shows long-standing illegal street sales (top manta) in Madrid where vendors use sheets with ropes to quickly escape police, not looted goods.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Todas las mantas tienen dos cuerdas cruzadas de esquina a esquina. En caso de que se acerque la policía, tiran de ellas y salen andando con total tranquilidad.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the specific modus operandi (sheets with ropes to evade police) and the sale of counterfeit goods in Madrid's Gran Vía as a recurring issue, directly substantiating the note's correction.
